setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step melody on the test device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 on pattern degrees 1 to 4 of scale slot 1 (C major), so MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97. No Trig params slot is assigned yet, playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Trig params, press K2 to enter the slot list and turn E3 to CC 1, press K3, then K2. Slot 1 now holds CC 1.
steps.title: Assign CC 1 to slot 1

steps.caption: Turn E2 one slot right, press K2, turn E3 to CC 2 and press K3, then K2. Slot 2 now holds CC 2 and slot 1 still holds CC 1.
steps.title: Assign CC 2 to slot 2

steps.caption: Repeat for slots 3, 4 and 5 (E2 to the next slot, K2, E3 to the next controller, K3, K2). Slot 5 now holds CC 5.
steps.title: Carry on to slot 5

steps.caption: Repeat for CC 6 up to CC 10 on slot 10. All ten slots are now assigned: the list holds CC 1 to CC 10, the most a channel can hold.
steps.title: Fill slots 6 to 10

steps.caption: Select slot 10 and keep turning E2 right: it stops at slot 10. Hold step 1 (1,4) and turn E3 to set the value to 0. Turn E2 left well past slot 1: it stops at slot 1. Hold step 2 (2,4) and set the value to 1. Tap Play (1,8). Before its note, step 1 sends CC 10 and step 2 sends CC 1: look for the two controller changes in the strip below. Tap Play again to stop.
steps.title: The first and last slots hold their ends

title: Use the first and last Trig params slots
